scope: Independent audit of executed cable evidence, task scope, replay presentation and next-session decision gates. No new simulator, GPU, rendering, training or hardware experiment. Recommendations are prospective, not passed gates.
preservation: Existing cable and peg negative evidence is unchanged. This audit narrows interpretation of a global retention stop; it does not reverse measured retention failure or declare the unexecuted extension ready.

summary.established: A pinned native UR5e/MuJoCo engineering adapter and scripted held seating on six deterministic local cases, with contact/load checks, complete request accounting and reproducible rigid-model axial extraction failure.
summary.not_established: A learned cable policy; recovery after a common competent failed attempt; benefit over strong recovery control; complete retained connection; realistic gripper release; random-population reliability; official AIC score; hardware transfer.
summary.main_design_error: The passive final-retention requirement became a global prerequisite even though native held insertion and official AIC terminal abstraction do not require a calibrated mechanical latch. The stricter retained-connection extension needs that gate; other explicitly scoped experiments need their own gates.
summary.main_research_gap: The competent scripted controller has no observed failures in the tiny tested support. There is currently no measured problem for the proposed learned recovery mechanism to solve.
summary.next_session: Freeze an explicit held-insertion contract and a visible physically causal cable-constraint scene; demonstrate feasible witnessed recovery with strong scripted controls; run one bounded residual-failure screen. Keep passive final retention separate. Train only if a meaningful unresolved learning question survives.

baseline_audit.confidence: high for recorded cases; unknown for population reliability

design.seed_interpretation: These label explicit deterministic layouts. The worker/scene builder use specified vectors and offsets; the inspected execution path does not consume these fields as RNG seeds. They are not three independent stochastic replications or training starts.
design.warmup: One separate nominal request per arm repeats a nominal layout; do not add to six-case denominators or count as independent coverage.

result.guided: scripted_force_guided_retry: held seating 6/6, including 3/3 nominal and 3/3 offset; zero retries, zero witnessed stalls and zero completions after its own witnessed stall.
result.continuation: scripted_continuation: held seating 3/6; 3/3 nominal, 0/3 offset. Three offset contact stalls end at the 30 s deadline.
result.pairing: Three concordant successes and three guided-only successes. Descriptive paired evidence on hand-built cases; no population significance or generalization claim.
result.endpoint: Within 1 mm and 0.03 rad, detector contact and 0.5 s held dwell under native raw wrist/plug 20 N aborts and 30 s deadline. Ideal fixed preset grasp; distal cable end free.

causal_interpretation: Guidance aligns to the actual simulated target and changes approach/force handling; continuation follows its initial axis and ignores a visible lateral correction. The demonstrated effect is local alignment/prevention against weak continuation.
Equal available observations do not make continuation a competent recovery comparator. The successful controller name contains retry, but no retry occurred.
Compensation, alignment and approach control change together. No compensation-only ablation isolates a force-bias benefit.
Continuation failures and guided successes have different action histories. They are not a shared failed state handed to competing recovery controllers.
Full simulated target/robot state and exact-model bias feedforward are idealizations. No camera perception or pose-estimation robustness is established.
baseline_audit.verification_limit: Previously reviewed native force streams and paired initialization are strong evidence. Poses saved every 10 ms cannot replay every native progress-window/dwell decision. This audit checked summaries, worker semantics and selected raw trajectories; it did not repeat all 1,536 baseline checks.

retention_and_benchmark_scope.confidence: high for pinned model and source semantics; no hardware inference

retention_result.fixture: Aligned one-axis force-driven rigid SC fixture with constrained lateral translation/rotation, no gripper and explicit gravity compensation.
retention_result.conditions: Three net extraction loads (0, 0.5, 2 N) at 0.25/0.125 ms; six deterministic fixture trials, not six independent hardware measurements.
retention_result.zero_net_load: 2/2 remain seated for 2 s; zero net force is not positive latch evidence.
retention_result.positive_net_load: 4/4 lose seating, about 12 ms at 0.5 N and 6 ms at 2 N; opposing contact is exactly zero in recorded native and refreshed extraction samples.
retention_result.supported_conclusion: Imported rigid geometry plus declared solver/friction lacks the tested axial retention. Held seating cannot become a completed passive connection claim.
unsupported: Real SC connectors have negligible retention.
AIC is invalid or cannot support useful insertion learning.

official_aic.documented_task: Single nearby insertion of a pregrasped known SC or SFP connector, other end free, Gazebo qualification with randomized board/component poses. No unseen geometry or released pull-retention test specified.
official_aic.completion_implementation: CablePlugin receives port touch, removes the existing gripper connection, makes BOTH cable endpoints static through fixed joints, later fixes the end effector and publishes a completion namespace. ScoringTier2 uses that namespace for correct/wrong insertion credit.
official_aic.interpretation: Official terminal connection is a simulation abstraction. Source behavior is consistent with not requiring the rigid collision geometry to supply passive latch retention. This is source-based inference, not a claim to know author intent.
official_aic.force_semantics: Documented startup-tared force over 20 N for more than 1 s incurs a scoring penalty; this differs from the project instantaneous native raw 20 N abort.
official_aic.boundary: Keep official predicates, scoring and terminal attachments separate from project pose/contact/dwell, hard aborts and no-attachment-change recovery. Native project held insertion is not an official AIC score; official Gazebo evaluation has not run.

scoped_gate_correction.valid_stop: Passive retained final connection, or recovery whose endpoint needs a physically detachable connector to resist load.
scoped_gate_correction.overbroad_stop: Explicit held insertion, insertion-policy engineering, cable-post correction, or separately validated guide retention when final connector release is outside the task.

contracts.endpoint: Contact/pose/dwell while maintaining preset grasp; seating and witnessed recovery after task-specific gates.
Pinned official Gazebo scoring/terminal abstraction and compliant observations/integration.
Engagement survives independently specified loads and genuine release controls without task-triggered attachment changes.

scoped_gate_correction.preservation: Original cycle/retention records stay valid for their stricter ambition. A successor must explicitly name its narrower endpoint; never silently relabel seating as retained connection.

physics_and_cost_audit.confidence: high for logged engineering measurements; unknown for changed-scene capacity
physics_and_cost_audit.numerical_support: One aligned layout seats/retracts at 0.5/0.25 ms, but other-contact peak differs about 12.5-fold and cable maximum displacement about 0.808 versus 0.376 m. Outcome agreement supports bounded engineering, not cable-contact convergence.
physics_and_cost_audit.failures_preserved: Two straight-cable initializations and a corrected-curve 1 ms initialization aborted. Do not reopen 1 ms merely because an older pending gate names it.

logged_capacity.scope: Single-environment CPU baseline cases with varying episode/log/render overhead; not sustained vectorized-training or GPU capacity.

physics_and_cost_audit.budget_implication: At 0.25 ms, 5 s initialization plus 45 s deadline is 200,000 native steps/request. Sixty-four full-deadline requests cost 12.8M steps, about 137 minutes at the slowest logged rate before extra new-scene overhead or review. The pending 90-minute block cannot assume that matrix fits.
stale_registration: cable_extension_registration_v1 is disabled with null board/clip/post/load/action/witness/budget fields; a checklist, not an executable task.
The native_nominal gate remains pending: six cases do not satisfy its prospective 18/20 requirement.
Its numerical gate still names 1/0.5 ms; successor settings must reflect existing failure evidence.
Native measured capacity must determine case counts/caps. Old peg 2,048-environment throughput is irrelevant.

presentation_audit.inspection_scope: Existing decoded poster visually inspected; render provenance/source and selected raw saved trajectories read. Complete MP4 not played/decoded in this audit. No rendering performed.
presentation_audit.integrity: Prior record reports verified 19.5 s saved-state replay, declared lexicographic case selection, original force/outcome data, explicit speed/final-frame labels and zero new native steps. Retain those qualities.
observations: Large gray jaws dominate and partly obscure the blue plug. Plug/port have similar blue appearance. Cyan span is a free cable, not another insertion tool.
Port is fixed in world without a visible mounting board/support; it reads as floating rather than an assembly fixture.
Whole-robot inset makes free cable tiny. No earlier clip, prior connection or snag explains why cable reasoning matters.
Short nearby approach is physically only about 23 mm guided path; continuation moves about 8 mm then stalls. Camera polish cannot create missing recovery behavior.
Successful arm prevents failure; comparison arm ignores visible 2 mm offset. This is an honest integration diagnostic but does not communicate a learned-recovery contribution.

raw_saved_pose_motion.method: Sum Euclidean differences of saved tip positions, plus first/last displacement. Roughly 10 ms samples plus terminal; sampled path length, not exact native integral.

next_demonstrator.scene: Rigidly mounted board/port and one cable obstacle or passive guide with real collision geometry. Show complete cable route, feasible lift/arc and goal. Any support geometry that can contact cable/robot creates a new task version requiring repeated controls.
next_demonstrator.story: Common competent approach, measured active contact/motion stall, actual repair, preserved required guide state and declared held-seating dwell or failure. Compare justified repair decisions on the same request. Add learned arm only after one exists and is evaluated.
next_demonstrator.camera: Board overview plus unobscured connector close-up; label gripper, plug, port, cable, obstacle. Visible metric scale, timestamp, witness, raw load limit and outcome. Do not enlarge physical motions or edit replay poses.
next_demonstrator.selection: Freeze representative-case rule before final outcome review; show unresolved failure alongside success and link complete case table/run/checkpoint when applicable.
next_demonstrator.minimum_deliverable: One short verified paired recovery clip with causal cable interaction, all-request outcome table and raw-force/progress trace. If no witnessed recovery occurs, publish competent scripted result without inventing a learning comparison.

prospective_acceptance_and_decision_tree.status: recommendations for successor registration; not executed or passed
prospective_acceptance_and_decision_tree.principle: Choose one explicit endpoint. Test phenomena that determine that endpoint and controller ranking, rather than proving every simulator detail correct.

steps.accept: Choose native held insertion as first achievable endpoint unless passive final release is explicitly required now. Freeze board/port/cable/obstacle geometry, material assumptions, actor/actions, witness, 30-45 s deadline, 0.5 s seating dwell and raw load limits. Keep final retention separate.
steps.branch: For full retained connection, require independently justified parameters and engaged/disengaged/load/actual-release controls. If mechanical specification is unavailable, record that extension as unready and continue explicitly scoped held insertion; do not invent an arbitrary latch.

steps.budget: Proposed ceiling: 90 wall minutes, 32 physical probes, 6M native steps, individual process <=10 minutes, 20% review reserve; stop at first reached ceiling. Recompute downward from changed-scene measured throughput. At most two implementation/controller correction rounds before a written decision.
accept: At least 18/20 nominal calibration requests meet frozen endpoint; all 20 count. Positive contact and shallow/side-contact negative controls distinguish seating from incidental touch.

Required cable constraint has intended capture/contact, possible physical release/loss and an executed action-only repair under measured slack/reach/force bounds. Fixed proximal anchor is an instrumented boundary assumption, not detachable connector retention.

Representative nominal/local/cable-only/combined cases at 0.25/0.125 ms use identical physical control/sensor cadence and matched preparation. Pass/fail, active witness, contact identity and constraint-loss classifications agree. Check representative cable discretization if narrow guide/post contact controls outcome.
Save native-rate witness/dwell inputs, phase/events, raw loads and forbidden-event counters for independent endpoint replay. Display poses may remain 10 ms.

Every admitted fault family has action-only feasible repair on calibration support at both selected resolutions; impossible knots, insufficient slack or unrecoverable grasp loss are not recovery-policy failures.
steps.branch: A material classification/support change permits one targeted correction and affected-control repeats for every arm. Persistent issue after correction allowance requires simpler supported geometry or closing extension. No indefinite timestep halving. Two settings assess sensitivity, not general convergence.

steps.budget: Start with 16 matched requests per required arm: four fault cells by four development layout/material constructions; two scripted arms mean 32 requests. At 5+45 s and 0.25 ms cap this is <=6.4M steps. Use 90 minutes only if newly measured rate leaves 20% review reserve; otherwise reduce/reallocate prospectively.
steps.accept: Compare competent target-aware force/search/retry with the same insertion controller plus visible cable repair. Equal available observations, geometry, loads, deadline and common first-attempt behavior. Assigned factors and realized interactions both recorded. Initial success/abort/timeout/process failure all count.
steps.cohort: Conditional recovery includes only active witnessed failures after the common competent attempt. Replay complete physical prefix per arm and verify matching; charge every replay. Do not force visible-state ignorance or tune a prefix to manufacture stalls.
steps.support_floor: At least four reproducible active combined/cable-interaction failures across at least two development layouts, with feasible calibration repairs. Mechanism-support floor, not statistical power or reliability evidence.
steps.branch: If first attempt succeeds throughout, retain simple method and reject present recovery premise. If cable-aware rules/planning resolve support, retain engineering result. Only feasible reproducible residual failures justify learned mechanism screen.

steps.budget: No automatic empty training smoke. Freeze overnight budget from measured native transitions, full optimization/export/reload work, RSS/GPU use and evaluation reserve only after supported question survives.
steps.accept: For consequence prediction, first register good/ineffective/damaging repairs with held-out layout/material manifests; compare persistence and simple local/geometric models; choose useful-error/calibration or action-ranking thresholds before fitting. For a recovery-training question, match total experience, nominal practice, architecture/history, tuning and checkpoint budget across ordinary/recovery-focused arms.
steps.pilot: Must change a decision: full rollout/optimizer/export/reload path, charged probes/failures/prefixes, measurable learning diagnostic and declared stop. One start is exploratory; target three independent starts only if question and budget warrant.
steps.branch: Failure to outperform simple models usefully or learn supported task in declared diagnostic budget closes/revises that specific mechanism. Passing earns smallest registered matched comparison, with final-test layouts sealed until selection ends.

prospective_acceptance_and_decision_tree.session_close: One decision record: task version, actual jobs/steps/wall, all failures, artifacts, untested claims and one next action. End with an executed engineering/research decision, including a negative decision that simple control suffices.

work: Read maintained documents and scoped JSON evidence
Read selected raw trajectories and calculate sampled motion
audit_accounting.limitations: No simulator/hardware execution, full MP4 review, exhaustive native-array revalidation, calibration or statistical test. Prior checks cited as prior evidence, not claimed rerun.
